title: Structural and extremal properties of $l_1$-Fiedler value
summary: The algebraic connectivity $a(G)$, defined as the second smallest eigenvalue of the Laplacian matrix $L(G)$, admits a well-known variational characterization involving the minimization of a quadratic form subject to an $\ell_{2}$-norm constraint. In a recent work, Andrade and Dahl (2024) proposed an analogous formulation based on the $\ell_{1}$-norm, leading to the introduction of a new graph parameter $b(G)$, referred to as the $l_1$-Fiedler value.
